en.title: Australia banned this anti-fascist play in 1936 at the request of the Nazis. Ninety years on, it's being staged again
en.summary: A production of Clifford Odets' 1935 play Till the Day I Die, which was banned by the Australian federal government in 1936 at Nazi Germany's request, is being remounted on a truck in Melbourne.
